discription: A simple FM synthesis bell sound with a fast ADSR envelope, allowing control over modulation ratio and index.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, modRatio=3.0, modIndex=5.0; var sig, modulator, carrier; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.001, 0.1, 0.0, 0.2, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); modulator = SinOsc.ar(freq * modRatio); carrier = SinOsc.ar(freq + (modulator * modIndex)); sig = carrier * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
